text: Long ago, a fisherman on this island caught nothing for forty days.
caption: Long ago, a fisherman on this island caught nothing for forty days.

text: On the forty-first night, a woman made of mist rose from the sea.
caption: On the forty-first night, a woman made of mist rose from the sea.

text: Give me your shadow, she whispered, and your nets will never be empty.
caption: “Give me your shadow,” she whispered, “and your nets will never be empty.”

text: What use is a shadow? He agreed.
caption: What use is a shadow? He agreed.

text: From that dawn, his nets overflowed.
caption: From that dawn, his nets overflowed.

text: But at noon, the village whispered. That man casts no shadow.
caption: But at noon, the village whispered: “That man casts no shadow.”

text: His own wife would not look at him.
caption: His own wife would not look at him.

text: So he rowed out, to beg for it back.
caption: So he rowed out, to beg for it back.

text: She gave it back. But it would not follow him.
caption: She gave it back. But it would not follow him.

text: It walked into the sea. He followed it, and never came back.
caption: It walked into the sea. He followed it, and never came back.

text: Now, on still nights, two shadows cross the bay.
caption: Now, on still nights, two shadows cross the bay.

text: One is his shadow. The other is him.
caption: One is his shadow. The other is him.
